## Purpose

Fit a second, backdated version of each saved placebo simulation to assess
out-of-sample prediction over the years just before its true placebo start.
The default window is **three years**, configurable through `backdate_years`.
The main fits are read from disk and never refitted or overwritten. This
notebook only prepares the diagnostic dataset; association analyses come later.

This is the covariate counterpart of 2.1, using the same mask, seeds, window,
summary functions and mid-p tails. Covariate scaling, FE formulas, INLA functions
(`fit_pm_c`, `fit_me_c`, `fit_sptiv_c`) and GB-Ens predictors match 2c. All original
panel columns are retained so the covariate models can use them. Scaling is done
once over the original panel, as in the main covariate fit; it does not use outcomes.
Main fits are read from `data/simulation/wcov/`, with the legacy `data/` fallback.

The default is a data-availability preflight (`run_fits: false`).
Enable only the new backdated fits with `-P run_fits:true`. First use a
small selection of simulations/models if desired; the full configuration is
3 scenarios x 200 simulations x 6 models, each with 200 draws. Input paths
are resolved from the repository root. CSV/RDS outputs go to `data/fits/backdate_wcov/`.

```{r setup}
# Find the repository and reuse shared functions, covariate specifications and history settings.
# Load the original panel and saved assignments, never generate new assignments.
library(data.table)
# Restore the source directory before the renderer reopens its relative input path.
# Preserve Quarto/knitr's existing document hook and capture paths outside fitting code.
knitr::knit_hooks$set(document = local({
  input <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
  source_dir <- normalizePath(dirname(input), mustWork = TRUE)
  previous <- knitr::knit_hooks$get("document")
  function(text) {
    setwd(source_dir)
    on.exit(setwd(source_dir), add = TRUE)
    if (is.function(previous)) previous(text) else text
  }
}))
here <- normalizePath(getwd())
repeat {
  if (file.exists(file.path(here, "R", "fe.r"))) break
  parent <- dirname(here)
  if (identical(parent, here)) stop("Cannot locate repository")
  here <- parent
}
root <- here
source(file.path(root, "R", "backdate_helpers.R"))
invisible(lapply(list.files(file.path(root, "R"), "\\.r$", full.names = TRUE), source))
if (!exists("params")) params <- list(run_fits = FALSE, backdate_years = 3L,
  nboot = 200L, simulations = 1:200, scenarios = 1:3,
  models = c("TWFE", "ETWFE", "RW", "RW-IID", "RW-ST", "GB-Ens"),
  mc_cores = 18L, audit_features = TRUE)
cfg <- params
h <- as.integer(cfg$backdate_years)
stopifnot(length(h) == 1L, h >= 1L, cfg$nboot >= 2L)
original <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(root, "data", "notpublic", "compact_dt.rds")))
panel <- backdate_covariate_panel(original)
rm(original); gc()
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(panel[, .(i, year)]))
stopifnot(all(panel[, .(ordered = all(diff(year) > 0)), by = i]$ordered))
sim_out <- readRDS(file.path(root, "data", "simulation", "simulated_assignments_with_meta.rds"))
assignments <- sim_out$assignments
if (is.null(cfg$simulations)) cfg$simulations <- seq_len(dim(assignments)[2])
stopifnot(setequal(dimnames(assignments)[[1]], as.character(unique(panel$i))),
          all(cfg$simulations %in% seq_len(dim(assignments)[2])),
          all(cfg$scenarios %in% seq_len(dim(assignments)[3])))
load(file.path(root, "data", "W"))
rownames(W) <- NULL
conf <- list(Lset = choose_lset(panel, shift_max = 3), graph = Matrix::Matrix(W))
options(xpn.conf = conf)
Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = 1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = 1, MKL_NUM_THREADS = 1)
INLA::inla.setOption(num.threads = 1)
specs <- backdate_specs(with_covariates = TRUE)
stopifnot(all(cfg$models %in% names(specs)))
scenario_names <- c("MAR", "Latent level", "Latent trend")
model_codes <- c(TWFE = "twfe", ETWFE = "etwfe", RW = "rw", `RW-IID` = "rwi",
                 `RW-ST` = "rwst", `GB-Ens` = "xgb")
output_dir <- file.path(root, "data", "fits", "backdate_wcov")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
seed_for <- function(sim, scenario) 203L + (scenario - 1L) * 10000L + sim
main_path <- function(model, scenario) {
  filename <- sprintf("wcov_imputation_%s_%s.rds", model_codes[[model]], scenario)
  paths <- file.path(root, c("data/simulation/wcov", "data"), filename)
  paths <- paths[file.exists(paths)]
  if (!length(paths)) stop("Missing main-fit file: ", filename)
  paths[[1L]]
}
```

## Eligibility before any new fit

All finite assignments are backdated together; counties with infinite
assignments are unchanged. Observed adoption dates remain unchanged for
cohort effects and for the original untreated-outcome mask. A county needs
at least two observed years before its fake start for a usable diagnostic.
This is a conservative screening rule, not a universal sufficient condition
for estimability. Report short history relative to the configured maximum
lag, zero pre-period counts (especially relevant for TWFE), and incomplete
held-out/post-period windows separately. No county is silently dropped and
no window is shortened. Counties still participate in the common masked
fit; diagnostics that cannot be evaluated are flagged and left unavailable.

```{r eligibility}
# Compare available history for the requested backdating window without fitting models.
# Save every pseudo-treated county, including those with unavailable untreated truth.
eligibility <- rbindlist(lapply(cfg$scenarios, function(k)
  rbindlist(lapply(cfg$simulations, function(r)
    backdate_eligibility(panel, assignments[, r, k], h, r, scenario_names[k], seed_for(r, k))))))
eligibility[, `:=`(insufficient_history = n_pre < 2L,
                   short_for_max_lag = n_pre < max(conf$Lset),
                   incomplete_heldout = n_ho != h, incomplete_post = n_post != 5L)]
fwrite(eligibility, file.path(output_dir, "eligibility.csv"))
eligibility[, .(county_simulations = .N, insufficient_history = sum(insufficient_history),
  short_for_max_lag = sum(short_for_max_lag), zero_pre_counts = sum(!positive_pre),
  incomplete_heldout = sum(incomplete_heldout), incomplete_post = sum(incomplete_post)),
  by = scenario]
```

## Separate backdated fits and main-fit joins

For each model/scenario, first verify all saved main-fit dates against the
assignment array and all saved observed outcomes/exposures against the panel.
A mismatch stops that group before backdated fitting. The main pre-fit RMSE
is recomputed from its saved point predictions over `year < x`, matching the
existing pre-fit definition. RMS Pearson residual is newly derived over the
same period where fitted means are positive, with its denominator recorded.

INLA reuses `impute_inla()` with missing responses. The fixed-effects imputer
fits only nonmissing responses and predicts the original rows; its bootstrap
now consistently uses `.dt`, rather than global `dt`. GB-Ens starts from raw
columns (including the four scaled covariates) and rebuilds history, neighbor, cohort and control context under the
backdated mask. It reuses its usual internal bootstrap and early stopping.
The leakage check perturbs all masked outcomes and verifies invariance of
features, propensity estimates, fitting data and validation masks. A failed
check or fit is recorded as `fit_failed`, not silently ignored.

The seed is deterministic by scenario and simulation, identical across
models. This preserves saved placebo datasets but does not reproduce
historical main-fit bootstrap/posterior random streams, which were not saved.
Poisson predictive counts use a separate stream. The same counts give
`ppp_ho_upper = mean(count > y_ho) + 0.5 * mean(count == y_ho)` and
`ppp_ho_lower = mean(count < y_ho) + 0.5 * mean(count == y_ho)`.
Both use the same predictive counts and split ties equally (mid-p).
`ppp_ho` aliases the upper tail; `tail_convention = "mid-p"` identifies new outputs.
The analysis computes `min(1, 2 * min(ppp_ho_upper, ppp_ho_lower))`.
Predictive counts are discarded after
these summaries are computed. The variance is calculated across **sums of latent mean
draws**, not sums of marginal variances or variances of noisy count draws.

```{r refit-and-save}
# Run only the new fits when explicitly enabled, collapse draws immediately, and join main summaries.
# Each model/scenario checkpoint contains county summaries only; shared main outputs are read-only.
if (isTRUE(cfg$run_fits)) {
  pieces <- list()
  for (k in cfg$scenarios) for (model in cfg$models) {
    main_file <- main_path(model, k)
    main_summary <- read_main_summary(main_file, panel, assignments, k, model)
    result <- parallel::mclapply(cfg$simulations, function(r) {
      run_backdate_one(panel, assignments[, r, k], h, r, scenario_names[k],
        seed_for(r, k), model, specs[[model]], cfg$nboot, cfg$audit_features)
    }, mc.cores = cfg$mc_cores, mc.set.seed = FALSE)
    if (any(vapply(result, inherits, logical(1), "try-error")))
      stop("Worker-level error for ", model, ", scenario ", k)
    result <- rbindlist(result, fill = TRUE)
    joined <- merge(result, main_summary, by = c("sim", "model", "id", "x"), all.x = TRUE)
    joined[, `:=`(covariate_adjusted = TRUE, main_file = main_file, nboot_requested = as.integer(cfg$nboot),
      main_status = fifelse(is.na(main_n_post), "missing_main_rows",
        fifelse(main_n_post != 5L, "incomplete_post_truth",
          fifelse(main_n_post_pred != 5L, "nonestimable_post_prediction", "ok"))))]
    stopifnot(nrow(joined) == nrow(result),
              !anyDuplicated(joined[, .(sim, model, id, x, scenario)]),
              !any(grepl("^y0_post_", names(joined))))
    saveRDS(joined, file.path(output_dir, sprintf("summary_%s_%s.rds", model_codes[[model]], k)))
    pieces[[length(pieces) + 1L]] <- joined
  }
  heldout <- rbindlist(pieces, fill = TRUE)
  setorderv(heldout, c("scenario", "sim", "model", "id"))
  saveRDS(heldout, file.path(output_dir, "heldout.rds"))
  fwrite(heldout, file.path(output_dir, "heldout.csv"))
  fwrite(heldout[, .N, by = .(model, scenario, heldout_status, main_status)],
         file.path(output_dir, "status_counts.csv"))
  saveRDS(list(parameters = cfg, with_covariates = TRUE, covariates = c("uemp", "pov", "mhinc", "aian"), assignment_metadata = sim_out$metadata,
    configuration = conf$Lset, RNGkind = RNGkind(), session = sessionInfo(),
    note = "No historical fit random streams are reconstructed; main outputs were not changed."),
    file.path(output_dir, "run_metadata.rds"))
  heldout[, .N, by = .(model, scenario, heldout_status, main_status)]
} else if (file.exists(file.path(output_dir, "heldout.rds"))) {
  # Render the completed run from saved summaries without executing any new fits.
  saved_heldout <- as.data.table(readRDS(file.path(output_dir, "heldout.rds")))
  cat("Displaying saved results; no models were refitted.\n")
  saved_heldout[, .N, by = .(model, scenario, heldout_status, main_status)]
} else {
  cat("Preflight complete. Set run_fits=true to create heldout.rds and heldout.csv.\n")
}
```

No full draws are persisted. `n_valid_draws` records posterior/bootstrap
prediction availability; if any requested draw is missing, variance and
all predictive-tail fields are left unavailable rather than calculated from a selected subset.
For incomplete held-out truth or fewer than two pre-fit years, held-out
predictions are unavailable. Main post-period summaries require all five
observable years and finite predictions. All such rows remain in the long
table, with diagnostic flags and messages. No performance associations,
correlations or regressions are computed here.
